candidate.version_description: This is a collaboration between prolific bluegrass banjoist Alison Brown and comedian Steve Martin, featuring bluegrass musicians Sam Bush (mandolin), Stuart Duncan (fiddle), Trey Hensley (guitar), and Todd Phillips (bass). These chords are based on those found on Chordify. Note: In the final chorus, you can play an F#7 or F#m7 instead of F#m if you think it sounds better.
